title: Depth
description: data of: depth.py TARGET --json. How faint one stack reaches: its zero point against Gaia DR3, the 5-sigma limit worked out from the noise in empty sky, and, with --plant, the share of planted stars the star finder gets back at each magnitude. Magnitudes are Gaia G; the camera is unfiltered. Also kept as depth.json beside the stack.

byRegion.description: One value per kind of background: sky, faint glow, bright glow, core (by the surface brightness of the glow above the sky). A kind with too few samples is left out.

share.description: Found over planted; null with fewer than 5 planted.

bright_end.description: Share found among the brightest planted stars. What is missing landed on a real star: the cost of crowding.

mag_90.description: Faintest magnitude at which 90% of the bright-end share is still found.

zeropoint.description: G magnitude of one unit of aperture flux in this stack.

calibration_scatter.description: Spread of the calibration stars about the zero point, magnitudes.

kinds.description: What kind of figure each is: measured, inferred, estimated, simulated, reported or not known.

completeness.description: With --plant: for the whole image (all) and each kind of background.

sweep.description: With --sweep: the same measured on the first 60, 120, 180, 300 and 600 s of the session's frames.
